matches.rationale: Pred_id 1 identifies the exact inconsistency: Lemma 3.1 states δ_p > 5||E|| but Theorem 2.1 requires only 4||E|| < δ_p, creating a gap in the proof. This detects the ground truth's strict vs. non-strict inequality inconsistency across the proof structure, even though the specific threshold differs slightly from what ground truth describes.

None of the findings identify the ambiguity about whether max is over ∂Γ₁ (boundary) vs Γ₁ (interior). Pred_id 4 discusses Theorem 2.3 but concerns a different issue (best rank-p approximation claim), not the notation ambiguity about the contour maximum.
